mutation createRec(
    $providerId: UUID!
    $acm: ACM!
){
	createSource(
        input: {
            name:"Federal Government Report",
            description: "Federal Government Report description"
            providerId: $providerId,
            tags: ["DIEKM Testing"]
            dateOfReport: "2023-04-27T14:15:30+00:00",
            dateOfInformation: "2023-04-27T14:15:30+00:00",
            identifier: "fedgov01"
            uri: "http://fedgov/01"
            dataAcm: $acm
            primaryTopic: "Government",
            secondaryTopic:"United States",
            acm: $acm
        }
  	) {
        id
        name
        description
        dateOfReport
        dateOfInformation
        primaryTopic
        secondaryTopic
        providerId
        acm
        identifier
        uri
    }
}
